summary: Evaluate selected basis functions into columns of a design matrix

identity.direction: Declared inputs to Evaluator yielding matrix of basis values
identity.definition: Evaluate selected basis functions into columns of a design matrix
identity.model: Construction delegates to the explicit source basis factory
identity.geometry: One-dimensional or planar sampled geometry as explicitly stated
identity.coordinates: Rows follow input domain; columns follow basis order
assumptions: Finite constructor samples and boundary-specific assumptions
Polynomial coefficients are ascending-power columns; poly_deg default3 means three basis functions
Spline keyword defaults n_knots=5,domain=(0,1); xdata/ydata supplied arrays must match

outputs.name: matrix
outputs.description: Evaluator yielding matrix of basis values

preconditions: Finite constructor samples and boundary-specific assumptions
Polynomial coefficients are ascending-power columns; poly_deg default3 means three basis functions
Spline keyword defaults n_knots=5,domain=(0,1); xdata/ydata supplied arrays must match
supported: Named analytic, manufactured, invariant or reference fixtures in the direct tests
excluded: Quartic and special-function factory selections are rejected; no invented implementations
Physical special-spline closures and unsupported knot domains remain unresolved

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Unsupported source input shape/domain may raise array, assertion, linear-algebra or SciPy errors; no missing-value or knot repair is inferred.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Underlying numerical or interpolation exceptions propagate.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Direct computation; inherited optimizer methods have no reliable crossing/convergence guarantee.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No guarantee of valid partially out-of-support results; class constructor exceptions do not return an object.
